title: Diesel Engine Service, Diagnosis and Repair Technician
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Diesel Engine Service, Diagnosis and Repair Technician Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Explain the theory of operation of diesel engines and their related sub-systems.
Demonstrate safety procedures when working on diesel engines and related electrical systems.
Communicate effectively to owners and operators of diesel powered trucks the required maintenance and repairs needed.
Demonstrate a thorough understanding of workplace expectations.
Apply proper troubleshooting techniques to diagnose and repair diesel engines.

notes: The page's heading is not printed in the extracted text; section_heading is inferred from the program title, award and source URL. The Requirements tab is headed 'Course List'.
MTRK 101 is printed as an 'or' alternative to MTRK 148 with no units beside it; the closed list stores 6 units.

The 1-Year Curriculum Map shows 'Total Units 20' because it lists MTRK 101 as 'Completion of MTRK 101 in summer' without counting its units; the Requirements tab states Total Units 26, which is recorded.
Outcomes are from the 'Certificate of Achievement Student Level Outcomes' tab, which has two lead-in sentences; both are omitted.

The career entry is taken from the description: 'prepared to work as entry-level technicians on diesel engines operating multiple equipment types including on-highway trucks, off-highway heavy equipment and stationary diesel power generation.'
